stock.description: Impression Dahongpao Co., Ltd. organizes, manages, and operates cultural tourism projects in China. The company operates Impression Dahongpao, a large-scale reality show; Jingshan Water Show; tea-infused hot springs and Da Hong Pao tea tasting experiences; and Center, Moonlit Wuyi, and Moonlit Wuyi projects. It sells tickets through distribution channels. Impression Dahongpao Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Wuyishan, China. Impression Dahongpao Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Wuyishan Cultural Tourism Co., Ltd.
